result.response: In this playthrough of *Chinese Paladin 4* (OpenPAL4), Yun Tianhe recruited Han Lingsha at Qingluan Peak (`Q01/N01`), retrieved the ancestral Sun-Shooting Bow (`射日猎弓`), switched the party leader to Han Lingsha to unlock the Shichen Creek Cave mechanism, defeated the sword spirit Kui Zhao (`M01/1`), and claimed the ice-sealed Wangshu Sword (`望舒剑`) (`M01/2`). Descending the mountain to Shouyang City (`Q02/N01`), the duo recruited Liu Mengli to learn Five-Element magic and ventured into Nvluo Cliff (`M04/1`), where they defeated the Huai Demon Elder to obtain the Earth Spirit Pearl (`土灵珠`). Finally, the party ascended to the Qionghua Sect (`Q07/N01`) to recruit Murong Ziying and forge the Xihe Sword (`羲和剑`) at the Chengtian Sword Forge, before confronting and defeating Xuan Xiao and Su Yao atop Juanyuntai (`M20/1`) to reach the grand ending at Qingluan Peak (`"game_cleared": true`).
